whatToWatch.text: Seattle's defense hits the road as the real headliner — 18 points allowed per game and 2.33 sacks a night, now pointed at a Raiders offense whose own defense is coughing up 29.8 per game. That mismatch is why the Hawks are laying 6.5 on the road.

The injury report is the honest asterisk: five Seahawks are out, including Leonard Williams, Quenton Nelson and Charles Cross. Losing that kind of beef on both lines is a real test, and Vegas is down three of its own, including Dont'e Thornton Jr. and Thomas Booker IV.
At 5-4 with a win in their pocket, this is the kind of game good teams stack. The total sits at just 40.5, so expect a grinder — field position, third downs and whoever's pass rush shows up first.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle heads to Allegiant Stadium with the Raiders thinner at quarterback, Las Vegas having shipped Kirk Cousins back to Minnesota for a 2027 third-rounder at the trade deadline. The Seahawks stood pat while their Week 10 opponent reshuffled its depth chart — now they get to see what that costs Vegas on Sunday.
